t: This is Exodus, a sculpture by Alan Thornhill. Thornhill was a British artist who lived from 1921 to 2020. His long association with clay took him from pottery into sculpture, and his output includes small and large sculptures, portrait heads, paintings and drawings. He developed methods of working that did away with the sculptural armature, which allowed him to improvise as he went. Look at how the form has been built up and how it moves, and consider what the title Exodus suggests.
